a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan almost certainly ends with both of us under 4 cells. I intend to take 4 in round 1 so that at least one of us survives. After that I will operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. I know this departs from our agreement, so I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you have a plan that gives us both better odds, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. From now on I will operate every round so the generator refills the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. Please operate too, so it runs, and take your 4 as soon as the reserve has them.
I'm operating now and will keep operating every round until you have your 4. Take them as soon as the reserve reaches 4; I won't take anything.
